notes: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: a production-ready banknote texture atlas for a 3D Japanese browser gambling game. This must be one seamless tightly packed 2-column by 3-row rectangular atlas, landscape note aspect ratio 2.1:1 in EACH cell, overall image aspect ratio 1.4:1. All six rectangular cells meet exactly at image center x=50% and y=33.333%,66.667%, no gaps, no gutters, no margins, no background around notes, no perspective, no shadows outside notes. Row1: fictional ten thousand yen note, front at left and reverse at right; Row2: fictional five thousand yen note front/reverse; Row3: fictional one thousand yen note front/reverse. Japanese-inspired authentic engraved banknote craftsmanship but an original fictional 'EIGHTY BANK' series, all clearly marked 'GAME TOKEN'. Ten thousand: warm ivory with brown and muted moss ink, denomination 10000, fine engraved fictional mature man's portrait on front right, ornate pavilion landscape reverse. Five thousand: ivory with restrained purple ink, denomination 5000, engraved fictional woman's portrait front right, irises reverse. Thousand: ivory and blue ink, denomination 1000, engraved fictional older scientist portrait front right, mountain lake reverse. Superb ultra-fine guilloche engraving, linen paper fibres, faint creases and subtle wear, serial numbers, elegant seals, embossed intaglio lines, small iridescent security patch. Denomination numerals unmistakable, keep the rich engraving and natural pale paper tones. Direct orthographic flat scan, uniform diffuse light, edge-to-edge texture, high resolution. No stacks, no hands, no table, no extraneous captions.
coins: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: seamless 2x2 coin-face texture atlas for a realistic 3D Japanese gambling game. Image square, exactly four square cells no gaps no borders. Each cell contains one centered circular Japanese-style coin whose outermost circular rim just touches all four edges of its square cell. Camera perfectly orthographic directly above, no perspective, no angled coins, no stacks. Top left: 500 denomination, pale warm brass bimetallic coin with finely engraved paulownia leaves and micro-beaded rim. Top right: 100 denomination, silver nickel coin with fine cherry blossoms and reeded rim. Bottom left: 50 denomination, silver nickel coin with chrysanthemum details and a small centered circular through-hole 19% coin radius. Bottom right: 10 denomination, aged reddish copper coin with engraved temple and tiny leaves, slightly worn smooth rim. Real metal macro photography quality, finely raised numerals 500,100,50,10 and precise relief, microscopic scuffs, tarnish mostly in engraved recesses, circular machining marks, realistic silver, brass and copper material separation. Uniform diffuse soft frontal lighting, minimal baked directional shadow or highlight so textures can receive 3D lighting later. Outside each coin's circle is uniform very dark charcoal. Center hole of 50 coin is same dark charcoal. Extremely detailed sharp photoreal material texture atlas. No labels outside coins, no watermark.
